# Acme Brand

The Acme look on top of Acme UI: the brand's pink accent and a rounder Button; everything else is Acme UI's.

## Consuming

Extends `acme-ui`. Load Acme UI's files first, then this kit's; wrap the page in `Acme.Root`. Namespace `AcmeBrand` holds only what this kit replaces.

- Button — The main way to act on a page, in the brand's rounded shape.
